outcome: Weight gain before and after pregnancy
cohort: A cohort of 100 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) was analysed, with 50 patients receiving routine health management and 50 patients receiving WeChat app-based health management.
finding: WeChat app-based health management effectively improved fasting plasma glucose and 2-hour postprandial blood glucose levels, reduced the incidence of adverse pregnancy outcomes, and decreased weight gain during pregnancy in patients with GDM.
